crossRefs.note: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.
Part your heavens, Yahweh, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.
Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.
Moses stretched out his rod toward the heavens, and Yahweh sent thunder and hail; and lightning flashed down to the…
Fire came out from before Yahweh, and devoured them, and they died before Yahweh.
Fire came out from Yahweh, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.
Elijah answered to the captain of fifty, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky, and consume you…
He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.
Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are?’

translations.web: Yahweh’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.
translations.bsb: The voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire.
translations.kjv: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.
translations.asv: The voice of Jehovah cleaveth the flames of fire.
